messages.author: e6b282337320955f
messages.subject: Problem using GGobi in Rattle
parts:
I am using RStudio and Rattle and trying to run GGobi. I get the following:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
unable to load shared object '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/rggobi/libs/x86_64/rggobi.so':
dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/rggobi/libs/x86_64/rggobi.so, 6): Library not loaded: /usr/local/ggobi/lib/libggobi.0.dylib
Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/rggobi/libs/x86_64/rggobi.so
Reason: image not found
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rggobi', details:
call: fun(libname, pkgname)
error: Could not load the rggobi library - please ensure GGobi is on the library path
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "ggobi"


Here is my sessionInfo():
> sessionInfo()
R version 2.15.2 (2012-10-26)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin9.8.0/x86_64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/C/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods base

other attached packages:
[1] cairoDevice_2.19 ellipse_0.3-7 pmml_1.2.34 XML_3.95-0.1 colorspace_1.2-1
[6] RGtk2_2.20.25 rattle_2.6.25

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tools_2.15.2

The problem doesn't seem to be specific to Rattle, but possibly RGtk2. Does anyone know what is the trick to getting this to work?

Brian

messages.author: 0d1c9d1288c176a9
messages.subject: RE: Problem using GGobi in Rattle
parts:
Hi Brian,i had the similar probleme.They said in Rstudio support page that the probleme is that rggobi tries to use Rgtk2 which is not well support in Rstudio. To use the package rggobi you  have to use R console alone(without Rstudio).                 http://support.rstudio.org/help/discussions/problems/3236-rggobi

regards,  

Baba Mohamed Doucoure
